rules.sentence: Although HLA-DQ2 or HLA-DQ8 is necessary for the development of celiac disease, it is insufficient, as many individuals carrying these alleles remain asymptomatic.
Gluten ingestion triggers the production of immunoglobulin A (IgA) autoantibodies against transglutaminase-3 (TG3), which deposit in the papillary dermis and are pathognomonic for the condition.
Similar to celiac disease, most individuals with dermatitis herpetiformis carry the HLA-DQ2 or HLA-DQ8 haplotypes.
